chunk_findings.detail: `snapshot` is captured only `if item else {}`, but `_reviewed_snapshot` is keyed off `it`, and `_record_review` previously included `_reviewed_snapshot(..., it, ...)` unconditionally. In the no-item/full-gate path `item` is `None` while the input tree `it` being reviewed can still exist (the tree whose head `_head_of` just returned on the previous line). With the input `api.review(repo, gate="critic")` (no `item`), line 2168 sets `snapshot={}`, so `_record_review` now records `**{}` instead of the `reviewed_paths` evidence for that full-gate review. That drops `reviewed_paths` from the recorded gate state and changes the next round's “reviewed paths unchanged” decision.
